description: Inspects a website URL for PHP runtime signatures (X-Powered-By, Server, WordPress cookies/assets) and evaluates exposure to the critical PHP2Shell vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619, CVSS 9.2).

url.description: Target website URL (e.g. 'https://example.com') to inspect for PHP runtime exposure and PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619).

name: scan_php_vulnerability
